Step 2 shows config-jurisdiction/provider/reviewer/comment; btn-next-step-3 disabled until reviewer filled, enables after. Step 3 shows check-safe (locked/always included), check-publication, check-pdf, btn-run-pipeline. /studies and /studies/new redirect to / (Wizard). /studies/{sid} renders SessionDetail with kicker 'RUN RECEIPT', Fraunces 'Handled.' headline, chip 'complete', btn-download-bundle enabled, publish-guard-panel with badge 'PHI-HANDLED · SAFE TO SHARE'.
critical_code_review_comments: Attestation.json 'reviewer' is null for the clean d36e4593 session because the run happened before the reviewer-identity invariant landed. New runs will populate it, but consider a one-shot backfill from session.session_review.reviewer at bundle-build time so historical sessions surface the reviewer in the attestation as well.

bundle.py._render_coverage_png hardcodes matplotlib defaults; consider set_dpi/figsize consistency across fig1/fig2 so both PNGs render at the same DPI (fig1=183KB vs fig2=52KB — probably OK, but confirm both are 300 dpi for print).

Wizard 'Step ONE/TWO/THREE' labels are uppercased via CSS text-transform; test spec used mixed-case matching. Not a bug, but worth documenting in the a11y section (screen readers still read 'Step one/two/three').

Legacy redirects /studies and /studies/new go to Wizard (correct). Confirm SEO / bookmark handling in a follow-up (maybe 301 vs client-side redirect); currently done via <Navigate replace/> which is fine for SPA.
